shortcut_probes.conclusion: One current member; a singleton cannot establish within-family variety or a repeated shortcut. Old batch had 2/2, strict regression fails there; current selection pass is 1/7 for this family. Baseline is uniform nonempty subset choice.

shortcut_probes.cue: Checkbox response shape
shortcut_probes.strategy: Predict exactly one selected statement (partial action only)
shortcut_probes.conclusion: 2/2 happen to be singletons, across two different families. This does not determine which box; their correct positions differ. The complete first-pass family controls vary count and position, and the entire batch also has a two-statement radio answer. Baseline 3/7 is the singleton share of seven valid masks. This limited count coincidence does not reproduce the old full-answer shortcut.

shortcut_probes.cue: Roman label / checkbox position without mathematical evidence
shortcut_probes.conclusion: Only 3/5 match; the exact batch has three distinct full answer subsets and five different recognizable families. Baseline 1/7 uses the conservative common space of seven nonempty subsets; radio banks may further restrict which action can be entered.

shortcut_probes.cue: Has a basis / has no basis wording
shortcut_probes.conclusion: Every finite-dimensional null space has a basis, including the empty basis of {0}. This is the mathematical proposition being assessed (source q-142479 and q-141214), not an incidental cue. Baseline is a random Boolean answer.

Actual publisher prepare_records identity, normalization, captured-inventory/within-batch deduplication and moderate filter
Native learner selection freshness, difficulty weights and within-band uniform selection, read-only source analysis

delivery.result: All 5 exact batch records, 87 independent controls and 73 first-pass records survive normalization/deduplication/difficulty filtering with identical prompt/answer decisions. Selection can only remove eligible first-pass records and cannot recreate duplicate family masks. Positive moderate weight and fresh history retain current survivors; live order and combined-pool distribution remain unclaimed.

limitations: Captured inventory basis 5418 only. Live learner histories, combined future inventory and active policy weights were not supplied; no exact live order or probabilities claimed. Applicable selection rules were examined read-only.
The exact batch has one member per recognizable family and cannot alone prove within-family breadth; first-pass and independently parameterized controls supply that evidence.
One incomplete source (q-47586) has no key/solution/difficulty and lacks its mathematically correct III-only bank choice; canonical example has no captured fields. No answer bank was invented.

No finite audit proves absence of every shortcut. Unchanged construction was checked by reused independent source/parser tests; fresh focus was changed selection, prior counterexamples and three small regression batches. Full domain comparison checks preservation only.
